ns2:course.label: Advanced Oral French
ns2:course.description: Intensive practice in oral French to improve fluency, vocabulary, comprehension, pronunciation and syntax. Activities include reports, discussion, and role-play in professional situations. Also includes written assignments based on class activities. May be repeated in separate terms (but not for credit in the major or minor) to a maximum of 4 hours. Prerequisite: FR 205 and FR 213 or equivalent.
